# py_ballisticcalc.cabi

The bclibc engines of [py_ballisticcalc](https://github.com/o-murphy/py-ballisticcalc) as **Cython over the C ABI of bclibc**
(`bclibc_ffi.h`, `BCLIBCFFI_*`), the layer `py_ballisticcalc.ctypes` binds with ctypes.

* one abi3 extension module (`py_ballisticcalc_cabi._native`) with the bclibc core and the C ABI wrapper compiled in: no shared
  library to load, no `auditwheel`/`delocate`, nothing of the C++ API exported;
* the declarations of the C ABI (`_bcffi.pxd`) are generated by autopxd2 from the header (`regenerate_bindings.py`), none is
  written by hand;
* the engines are `cabi+euler`, `cabi+rk4`, `cabi+verlet`, `cabi+rkck`, `cabi+dopri`, `cabi+tsitouras`; the buffers
  `CythonizedBaseTrajSeq` and `CythonizedBaseTrajData` have the names of those of `py_ballisticcalc.exts`.

Needs bclibc 2.2 or later (the buffer and the interpolation of base trajectory points, and the error kinds, are in its C ABI).

```
pip install py_ballisticcalc py_ballisticcalc.cabi
python -c "from py_ballisticcalc import Calculator; Calculator(engine='cabi+dopri')"
```
